description:
The Legal, Audit, and Compliance team at Clear Capital partners collaboratively across the organization to deliver reliable, timely counsel on a wide range of legal, compliance, risk, audit, and customer support matters. This team shapes compliant, effective strategies and policies that drive organizational growth and leadership. This generalist position is vital for supporting our commercial efforts and product, data protection, privacy and AI initiatives, reporting directly to the VP of Compliance and Managing Counsel.
 
 

What You Will Work On

  • Draft, negotiate, and manage commercial agreements, templates, and playbooks across product, data + analytics, and affiliate business lines. 
  • Support audit, risk, and regulatory compliance programs, including policy development, internal controls, and responses to customer due diligence and data protection reviews. 
  • Develop and deliver practical training and guidance to business teams on legal, compliance, privacy, and contract requirements. 
  • Provide legal guidance on data privacy and protection requirements, including applicable U.S. and international privacy laws and regulations. 
  • Monitor emerging legal and regulatory developments affecting real estate valuation, data, and AI, and translate them into clear, actionable guidance for the business. 
  • Advise business stakeholders on responsible AI practices, including transparency, accountability, human oversight, bias, explainability, and 
  • appropriate use of AI-generated outputs. 
  • Monitor evolving AI laws and regulations and assess their potential impact on the company's business operations, products, and services. 
  • Support of International Affiliates & Global Legal Operations 
  • Provide legal support and guidance to the company's international subsidiaries, affiliates, and other global business operations. 
  •  Advise on cross-border commercial transactions, intercompany agreements, international contracting, and global business initiatives. 
  • Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable local laws and regulations across the jurisdictions in which the company operates. 
  • Develop and promote consistent legal policies, contract standards, and governance practices across the company's global entities while accounting for local legal requirements. 

    • Who We Are Looking For

  • Juris Doctor required with active bar license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  •  Minimum of 5 years experience at a law firm and/or in-house, with experience in commercial transactions and employment law, and in data protection or intellectual property matters, including developing data management programs as well as solid understanding of applicable privacy laws including GLBA, CPRA, and others. 
  • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment laws, with practical experience advising HR on hiring, leaves, accommodations, performance management, investigations, and terminations. 
  • Experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating various commercial software licenses, SAAS, and data licensing agreements, ideally in real estate valuation or financial services industries. 
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with others across various internal business units.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and conflict resolution skills. Must be comfortable navigating healthy tension with organizational units and third parties. 
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, able to meet aggressive deadlines, able to adapt quickly to change in direction, and demonstrate willingness and ability to learn new concepts/software/industries quickly. 
  • Anticipate internal and external business challenges and provide creative problem-solving solutions to analyze legal and commercial risks while supporting corporate strategy and goals. 
  • Prior experience with Ironclad or a similar contract lifecycle management (CLM) tool is preferred. 
  • Prior experience advising on multi-state employment matters, including hiring, leaves, terminations, wage and hour, agreements and policies, employee relations, investigations, and transaction diligence is preferred. 
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude) to build and maintain contract playbooks, clause libraries, and contract review workflows is preferred. 

    • What You Can Expect

  • Compensation: The base salary for this position ranges from $150,400 to $206,600 annually, depending on your location, experience, and qualifications. Additional compensation offerings include a company profit-sharing bonus program, communication stipends, and referral bonuses.
  • Inclusive benefits package offering: Comprehensive medical, dental, and company paid vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, voluntary life and AD&D insurance options, voluntary supplemental insurances for accident, critical illness, and legal services, paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays, employee assistance and wellness programs, company paid short term disability coverage, company contributions to health saving funds (with participation in the high deductible health plan. We offer company-paid access to Galileo for virtual primary care and Rula for virtual mental health resources.
  • Through our Anniversary Program, we celebrate the meaningful milestones and long tenure that reflect how much we value your contributions and commitment to our team.
  • Career and skill development resources to help advance your career and personal growth.
  • A mission-driven environment where your work makes a measurable impact on the real estate industry.

    • What We Value

  • Wherever it Leads, Whatever it Takes® - No matter how remote, complex, or unexpected. Our commitment never wavers. 
  • Hire NICE people - Skills can be taught but character shines through. We seek those who bring integrity, kindness, and grit. 
  • Lift others up - We lead with empathy and strive to improve the lives of those around us. ● Sweat the details - Excellence lives in the little things. Getting it just so is how we make a big impact. 
  • Raise the bar - We don’t settle for industry standards, we redefine them.
    •  
    About Us 
     
    Clear Capital is a national real estate analytics, data solutions and valuation technology company with a simple purpose: to build confidence in real estate decisions to strengthen communities and improve lives. Our goal is to provide customers with a complete understanding of nearly every U.S. property through our AI-driven analytics, data solutions, valuation services and automated appraisal review platforms. Our commitment to excellence - wherever it leads, whatever it takes® - is embodied by our team members across our brands and has remained steadfast in this pursuit since our first order in 2001. 
     
    Clear Capital is an equal-opportunity employer. 

    To all recruitment agencies: Clear Capital does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Clear Capital employees, or any other company location. Clear Capital is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
